> Sequencing: Track A (typecheck) lands first and brings the shared infra (`path-denylist`, `adversarial-settings` module, `Promise.allSettled` shell, `validateAllFiles`, hygiene denylist filter, methodology composite-pin scaffold). Track B (diff) adds the diff utility to the orchestration shell AND adds the diff data fields AND adds the diff directive prose all in one PR. Track C (per-runner model selection) extends the runner job interfaces and wires the route handlers. Composite-pin tests are the safety net per R4.10.

> R3.11 same-PR constraint: Tasks 19, 20, and 22 land in a single PR (per requirements R3.11 — docs ship with the Track-C code, not as a follow-up). Each task still gets its own dashboard task review during implementation; only the final commit is bundled.

## Track A — Typecheck pre-computation + shared infra

- [ ] 1. Create path-denylist module in src/core/path-denylist.ts

  - Case-folding rules: secret-bearing basenames/suffixes/prefixes always case-folded; lock-file basenames + binary-suffix entries case-folded only on case-insensitive volumes; path-segment matches unconditionally case-insensitive.
  - Test-fixture exception (R1.6 narrowed) applies ONLY to path-segment denylist; basename/suffix/prefix rules continue to apply.
  - Purpose: single source of truth for lock/secret/binary path filtering, consumed by both `computeTaskDiff` (Track B) and `computeHygieneSignals`.
